PARTIAL PASS — One correction remaining

I have reviewed both uploaded V2 screenshots. The mobile connector problem is resolved, and the diagram is substantially clearer than the original text-based architecture.

However, the Raspberry Pi services branch still appears in the main communication path rather than as a separate branch.

Do not redesign the diagram again. Only correct the services and Mobile App relationship.

1. Mobile directional connectors — APPROVED
The V2 mobile architecture now has directional connectors between the stacked subsystem cards.

The new downward connectors between Sensor WROOM and Console WROOM, and between ESP32-S3 and Raspberry Pi, are visible.

All major components remain readable and fit within the mobile viewport. The UART Bridge retains its packet details, and the system follows a consistent top-to-bottom layout.

This issue is resolved. Do not modify these connectors again.

2. Raspberry Pi services — One remaining issue
The V2 desktop diagram retains the services panel between the Raspberry Pi and Mobile App.

In both screenshots, the visual sequence remains:

Raspberry Pi

Raspberry Pi Services

Mobile App

This still suggests that the Mobile App receives data through the services panel.

The intended architecture, as reported in your previous milestone, identifies the services as capabilities of the Raspberry Pi backend and the Mobile App as a separate endpoint connected to that backend.

Changing the services label or making the panel smaller does not resolve the ambiguity while it remains directly between the Raspberry Pi and Mobile App.

Required correction

Keep the existing subsystem cards, but change their relationship so the services are visually subordinate to the Raspberry Pi without interrupting the primary path to the Mobile App.

On desktop, the services can appear as a branch extending from the Raspberry Pi, while the Mobile App remains connected to the backend.

On mobile, a simpler solution is to place the services inside the Raspberry Pi subsystem container as a nested detail panel, with the downward connection to the Mobile App originating from the overall Raspberry Pi subsystem.

This is a localized presentation change. Do not rebuild the architecture or introduce another diagramming system.
